items.question: Trong câu "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", từ "compile" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", what does "compile" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compile /kəmˈpaɪl/ (động từ): biên soạn, tập hợp. "Compile a report / a list" = biên soạn báo cáo / danh sách; trong lập trình từ này còn có nghĩa "biên dịch".
items.explanationEn: compile /kəmˈpaɪl/ (verb): to collect and put together. "Compile a report / a list" means gathering material into one document; in programming it also means to convert code.

items.question: Trong câu "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", từ "reference" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", what does "reference" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (danh từ): tài liệu tham khảo. "A standard reference" = tài liệu tham khảo chuẩn; "for reference" = để tham khảo.
items.explanationEn: reference /ˈref.ər.əns/ (noun): a source you consult. "A standard reference" is the source people consult by default; "for reference" means for consulting later.

items.question: Trong câu "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", từ "profession" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", what does "profession" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: profession /prəˈfeʃ.ən/ (danh từ): nghề (chuyên môn). "The business analysis profession" = nghề phân tích nghiệp vụ; tính từ: professional (chuyên nghiệp).
items.explanationEn: profession /prəˈfeʃ.ən/ (noun): a skilled occupation. "The business analysis profession" is the occupation as a whole; adjective: professional.

items.question: Trong câu "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", từ "systematise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BABOK (Business Analysis Body of Knowledge) is the standard reference compiled by the IIBA (International Institute of Business Analysis), systematising what the business analysis profession covers.", what does "systematise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: systematise /ˈsɪs.tə.mə.taɪz/ (động từ): hệ thống hóa. Systematise (Anh-Anh) / systematize (Anh-Mỹ): sắp xếp kiến thức rời rạc thành một hệ thống có trật tự.
items.explanationEn: systematise /ˈsɪs.tə.mə.taɪz/ (verb): to arrange into a system. Systematise (UK) / systematize (US): to turn scattered knowledge into an ordered system.

items.question: Trong câu "A mandatory process to follow step by step.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A mandatory process to follow step by step.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory field" = trường bắt buộc; trái nghĩa: optional (tùy chọn).
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tɔːr.i/ (adjective): required by rule. "A mandatory field" must be filled in; the opposite is optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Something you must memorise to do the job.", từ "memorise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Something you must memorise to do the job.", what does "memorise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (động từ): học thuộc lòng. Memorise (Anh-Anh) / memorize (Anh-Mỹ); BABOK không cần học thuộc mà dùng như bản đồ.
items.explanationEn: memorise /ˈmem.ə.raɪz/ (verb): to learn by heart. Memorise (UK) / memorize (US); BABOK is a map to consult, not a text to learn by heart.

items.question: Trong câu "A shared vocabulary so practitioners across organizations understand each other.", từ "practitioner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A shared vocabulary so practitioners across organizations understand each other.", what does "practitioner" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person working in a field
items.explanation: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (danh từ): người hành nghề. "BA practitioners" = những người làm BA thực tế; hay gặp trong tài liệu chuyên ngành và tin tuyển dụng.
items.explanationEn: practitioner /prækˈtɪʃ.ən.ər/ (noun): a person working in a field. "BA practitioners" are people who actually do the work; common in professional texts and job ads.

items.question: Trong câu "The most pragmatic way to use BABOK: treat it as a map rather than a mandatory route.", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most pragmatic way to use BABOK: treat it as a map rather than a mandatory route.", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (tính từ): thực tế, thực dụng. "A pragmatic approach" = cách tiếp cận thực tế, chú trọng cái dùng được thay vì lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmæt.ɪk/ (adjective): practical and sensible. "A pragmatic approach" focuses on what works in practice rather than on theory.

items.question: Trong câu "When a project is struggling and you cannot say why, comparing against the knowledge areas usually points straight at what is being skipped.", từ "struggle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a project is struggling and you cannot say why, comparing against the knowledge areas usually points straight at what is being skipped.", what does "struggle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (động từ): gặp khó khăn, chật vật. "A struggling project" = dự án đang gặp khó; "struggle with something" = chật vật với việc gì.
items.explanationEn: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (verb): to have serious difficulty. "A struggling project" is in trouble; "struggle with something" means finding it hard.

items.question: Trong câu "When a project is struggling and you cannot say why, comparing against the knowledge areas usually points straight at what is being skipped.", từ "skip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a project is struggling and you cannot say why, comparing against the knowledge areas usually points straight at what is being skipped.", what does "skip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: skip /skɪp/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "Skip a step / a meeting" = bỏ qua một bước / một cuộc họp; "most-skipped" = bị bỏ qua nhiều nhất.
items.explanationEn: skip /skɪp/ (verb): to leave out. "Skip a step / a meeting" means not doing it; "most-skipped" means left out most often.

items.question: Trong câu "Business Analysis Planning and Monitoring — Planning the analysis work itself: which approach, who participates, what deliverables, how effectiveness is measured.", từ "deliverable" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business Analysis Planning and Monitoring — Planning the analysis work itself: which approach, who participates, what deliverables, how effectiveness is measured.", what does "deliverable" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (danh từ): sản phẩm bàn giao. "Project deliverables" = các sản phẩm phải bàn giao của dự án (tài liệu, sơ đồ, phần mềm…).
items.explanationEn: deliverable /dɪˈlɪv.ər.ə.bəl/ (noun): an output to hand over. "Project deliverables" are the outputs a project must hand over, such as documents or software.

items.question: Trong câu "Business Analysis Planning and Monitoring — Planning the analysis work itself: which approach, who participates, what deliverables, how effectiveness is measured.", từ "effectiveness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business Analysis Planning and Monitoring — Planning the analysis work itself: which approach, who participates, what deliverables, how effectiveness is measured.", what does "effectiveness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: effectiveness /ɪˈfek.tɪv.nəs/ (danh từ): mức độ hiệu quả. Effectiveness = đạt đúng mục tiêu; phân biệt với efficiency = ít tốn nguồn lực.
items.explanationEn: effectiveness /ɪˈfek.tɪv.nəs/ (noun): how well something works. Effectiveness means achieving the goal; efficiency means using few resources.

items.question: Trong câu "Many BAs dive straight into interviews without pausing to ask", từ "dive into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many BAs dive straight into interviews without pausing to ask", what does "dive into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: dive into /daɪv ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lao ngay vào (làm gì). "Dive straight into something" = lao ngay vào việc gì mà không chuẩn bị; "a deep dive" = phân tích sâu.
items.explanationEn: dive into /daɪv ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to start something at once. "Dive straight into something" means starting without preparation; "a deep dive" is a detailed analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing out information and sustaining collaboration with stakeholders.", từ "sustain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing out information and sustaining collaboration with stakeholders.", what does "sustain" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to suffer a loss or injury
items.explanation: sustain /səˈsteɪn/ (động từ): duy trì. "Sustain collaboration / growth" = duy trì sự hợp tác / tăng trưởng; tính từ: sustainable (bền vững).
items.explanationEn: sustain /səˈsteɪn/ (verb): to keep going over time. "Sustain collaboration / growth" means keeping it going; adjective: sustainable.

items.question: Trong câu "In practice this consumes the most time.", từ "consume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In practice this consumes the most time.", what does "consume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (động từ): tiêu tốn. "Time-consuming" = tốn thời gian; "consume resources" = tiêu tốn tài nguyên.
items.explanationEn: consume /kənˈsuːm/ (verb): to use up. "Time-consuming" means taking a lot of time; "consume resources" means using them up.

items.question: Trong câu "Managing requirements over time: tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, assessing change, obtaining approval.", từ "obtain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Managing requirements over time: tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, assessing change, obtaining approval.", what does "obtain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (động từ): xin được, đạt được. "Obtain approval / permission" = xin được sự phê duyệt / cho phép; trang trọng hơn "get".
items.explanationEn: obtain /əbˈteɪn/ (verb): to get, to acquire. "Obtain approval / permission" means getting it; more formal than "get".

items.question: Trong câu "Managing requirements over time: tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, assessing change, obtaining approval.", từ "prioritize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Managing requirements over time: tracing, maintaining, prioritizing, assessing change, obtaining approval.", what does "prioritize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (động từ): xếp thứ tự ưu tiên. "Prioritize requirements" = sắp thứ tự ưu tiên cho yêu cầu; danh từ: priority.
items.explanationEn: prioritize /praɪˈɒr.ɪ.taɪz/ (verb): to rank by importance. "Prioritize requirements" means deciding which come first; noun: priority.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding the need at a strategic level: current state, desired state, gap analysis, scope, and risk.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding the need at a strategic level: current state, desired state, gap analysis, scope, and risk.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): khoảng chênh lệch. "Gap analysis" = phân tích khoảng cách giữa hiện trạng (current state) và trạng thái mong muốn (desired state).
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a difference between two states. "Gap analysis" compares the current state with the desired state.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysing, modeling, specifying, identifying solution options, and evaluating them.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysing, modeling, specifying, identifying solution options, and evaluating them.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): đặc tả, nêu rõ. "Specify requirements" = đặc tả yêu cầu; danh từ: specification (bản đặc tả, spec).
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state precisely. "Specify requirements" means stating them precisely; noun: specification (spec).

items.question: Trong câu "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many teams ship a feature and move to the next without ever checking whether it solved the original problem.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): phát hành (sản phẩm). "Ship a feature" = phát hành tính năng tới người dùng; từ lóng phổ biến trong ngành phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to release to users. "Ship a feature" means releasing it to users; very common in software teams.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are not lying around waiting to be picked up — they must be DRAWN OUT.", từ "draw out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are not lying around waiting to be picked up — they must be DRAWN OUT.", what does "draw out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: draw out /drɔː aʊt/ (cụm từ): khơi gợi, moi ra. "Draw out information" = khơi gợi thông tin từ người khác; đây chính là tinh thần của từ "elicitation".
items.explanationEn: draw out /drɔː aʊt/ (phrase): to get information from someone. "Draw out information" means getting people to share it; that is the spirit of "elicitation".

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements are not lying around waiting to be picked up — they must be DRAWN OUT.", từ "lie around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements are not lying around waiting to be picked up — they must be DRAWN OUT.", what does "lie around" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lie around /laɪ əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): nằm sẵn đâu đó. "Lie around" = nằm lăn lóc, có sẵn chờ người nhặt; yêu cầu thì không như vậy.
items.explanationEn: lie around /laɪ əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to be left somewhere, unused. "Lie around" means being left somewhere for anyone to pick up; requirements are not like that.

items.question: Trong câu "Many needs only surface once they see a solution.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many needs only surface once they see a solution.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. "Issues surface late" = vấn đề lộ ra muộn; danh từ surface = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜː.fɪs/ (verb): to appear, to become known. "Issues surface late" means they become visible late; the noun means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Much of what they know goes unsaid because they consider it obvious.", từ "unsaid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Much of what they know goes unsaid because they consider it obvious.", what does "unsaid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unsaid /ʌnˈsed/ (tính từ): không được nói ra. "Go unsaid / be left unsaid" = không được nói ra; điều người dùng bỏ qua vì cho là hiển nhiên.
items.explanationEn: unsaid /ʌnˈsed/ (adjective): not spoken aloud. "Go unsaid / be left unsaid" means nobody mentions it, often because it seems obvious.

items.question: Trong câu "This is tacit knowledge — the BA's main enemy.", từ "tacit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is tacit knowledge — the BA's main enemy.", what does "tacit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tacit /ˈtæs.ɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm, không nói thành lời. "Tacit knowledge" = tri thức ngầm (ai cũng biết nhưng không ai viết ra); "tacit agreement" = đồng ý ngầm.
items.explanationEn: tacit /ˈtæs.ɪt/ (adjective): understood without words. "Tacit knowledge" is known but never written down; "tacit agreement" is agreement without words.

items.question: Trong câu "Different groups describe the same process differently, and nobody knows they are contradicting each other.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Different groups describe the same process differently, and nobody knows they are contradicting each other.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn với. "Contradict each other" = mâu thuẫn nhau; danh từ: contradiction.
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to say the opposite of. "Contradict each other" means their statements cannot both be true; noun: contradiction.

items.question: Trong câu "Define a concrete goal for this session.", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Define a concrete goal for this session.", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "A concrete goal / example" = mục tiêu / ví dụ cụ thể; trái nghĩa: abstract, vague.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋ.kriːt/ (adjective): specific and definite. "A concrete goal / example" is specific; the opposite is abstract or vague.

items.question: Trong câu "Prepare questions but do not cling to the list.", từ "cling to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prepare questions but do not cling to the list.", what does "cling to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: cling to /klɪŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): bám chặt vào. "Cling to a plan / an idea" = khư khư bám lấy kế hoạch / ý tưởng dù không còn phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: cling to /klɪŋ tuː/ (phrase): to hold on tightly to. "Cling to a plan / an idea" means refusing to let go even when it no longer fits.

items.question: Trong câu "The best answers usually come from follow-up questions.", từ "follow-up" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best answers usually come from follow-up questions.", what does "follow-up" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: follow-up /ˈfɒl.əʊ.ʌp/ (tính từ): tiếp nối, hỏi thêm. "Follow-up question / meeting" = câu hỏi / cuộc họp tiếp nối; động từ: follow up on something.
items.explanationEn: follow-up /ˈfɒl.əʊ.ʌp/ (adjective): coming after as a continuation. "A follow-up question / meeting" continues an earlier one; verb: follow up on something.

items.question: Trong câu "Send the topic in advance so they can think.", từ "in advance" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Send the topic in advance so they can think.", what does "in advance" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (cụm từ): trước (thời điểm đó). "Send the agenda in advance" = gửi chương trình họp trước; cụm rất hay dùng trong email công việc.
items.explanationEn: in advance /ɪn ədˈvɑːns/ (phrase): beforehand. "Send the agenda in advance" means sending it beforehand; very common in work emails.

items.question: Trong câu "Start with open questions, narrowing with closed ones to confirm.", từ "narrow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start with open questions, narrowing with closed ones to confirm.", what does "narrow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (động từ): thu hẹp. "Narrow down the options" = thu hẹp các lựa chọn; tính từ narrow = hẹp.
items.explanationEn: narrow /ˈnær.əʊ/ (verb): to make more limited. "Narrow down the options" means reducing them; the adjective means not wide.

items.question: Trong câu "Paraphrase frequently — the single most powerful technique.", từ "paraphrase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Paraphrase frequently — the single most powerful technique.", what does "paraphrase" (verb) mean?
options: diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác
items.explanation: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (động từ): diễn đạt lại bằng lời khác. Paraphrase giúp xác nhận đã hiểu đúng: "So if I understand correctly, ..." (Nếu tôi hiểu đúng thì…).
items.explanationEn: paraphrase /ˈpær.ə.freɪz/ (verb): to restate in other words. Paraphrasing checks understanding: "So if I understand correctly, ..."

items.question: Trong câu "Use deliberate silence.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use deliberate silence.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. "Deliberate silence" = sự im lặng có chủ đích; trạng từ: deliberately (cố ý).
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (adjective): done on purpose. "Deliberate silence" is silence used on purpose; adverb: deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "A great deal of valuable information arrives in that pause.", từ "a great deal of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A great deal of valuable information arrives in that pause.", what does "a great deal of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: a great deal of /ə ɡreɪt diːl əv/ (cụm từ): rất nhiều. "A great deal of" đi với danh từ không đếm được: a great deal of time / information.
items.explanationEn: a great deal of /ə ɡreɪt diːl əv/ (phrase): a large amount of. "A great deal of" goes with uncountable nouns: a great deal of time / information.

items.question: Trong câu "buys you a meaningless nod.", từ "meaningless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "buys you a meaningless nod.", what does "meaningless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (tính từ): vô nghĩa. Câu hỏi mớm chỉ đổi lấy "a meaningless nod" = cái gật đầu vô nghĩa, không phản ánh nhu cầu thật.
items.explanationEn: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (adjective): without real meaning. A leading question only gets "a meaningless nod" that says nothing about the real need.

items.question: Trong câu "Write it up within 24 hours, while memory is fresh.", từ "write up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write it up within 24 hours, while memory is fresh.", what does "write up" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to produce a full written record
items.explanation: write up /raɪt ʌp/ (cụm từ): viết thành bản hoàn chỉnh. "Write up the notes / minutes" = soạn lại ghi chú / biên bản; danh từ: a write-up.
items.explanationEn: write up /raɪt ʌp/ (phrase): to produce a full written record. "Write up the notes / minutes" means turning them into a clean document; noun: a write-up.

items.question: Trong câu "Write it up within 24 hours, while memory is fresh.", từ "fresh" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write it up within 24 hours, while memory is fresh.", what does "fresh" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fresh /freʃ/ (tính từ): còn mới, còn rõ. "While it is fresh in your mind" = khi còn nhớ rõ; "a fresh start" = khởi đầu mới.
items.explanationEn: fresh /freʃ/ (adjective): recent and not yet faded. "While it is fresh in your mind" means while you still remember it clearly; "a fresh start" is a new beginning.

items.question: Trong câu "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Separate: confirmed facts / assumptions to verify / open questions / decisions made.", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that it is true
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác minh. "Assumptions to verify" = các giả định cần xác minh; danh từ: verification.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check that it is true. "Assumptions to verify" still need checking; noun: verification.

items.question: Trong câu "Send it back to the interviewee for confirmation.", từ "interviewee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Send it back to the interviewee for confirmation.", what does "interviewee" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interviewee /ˌɪn.tə.vjuːˈiː/ (danh từ): người được phỏng vấn. Hậu tố -ee chỉ người nhận hành động (interviewee, employee); -er chỉ người làm (interviewer).
items.explanationEn: interviewee /ˌɪn.tə.vjuːˈiː/ (noun): the person being interviewed. The suffix -ee marks the receiver (interviewee, employee); -er marks the doer (interviewer).

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most-skipped step and the one that causes the most defects.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most-skipped step and the one that causes the most defects.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. "Defect" trong phần mềm = lỗi (gần nghĩa bug); "defect rate" = tỷ lệ lỗi.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. In software a defect is close to a bug; "defect rate" is the share of faulty items.

items.question: Trong câu "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "Workshops suit..." = workshop phù hợp với…; tính từ: suitable (phù hợp).
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "Workshops suit..." means they are right for those cases; adjective: suitable.

items.question: Trong câu "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", từ "perspective" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", what does "perspective" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (danh từ): góc nhìn, quan điểm. "From a business perspective" = từ góc nhìn kinh doanh; rất hay gặp trong họp và tài liệu.
items.explanationEn: perspective /pəˈspek.tɪv/ (noun): a point of view. "From a business perspective" means from the business point of view; very common at work.

items.question: Trong câu "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", từ "simultaneously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Workshops suit: needing several perspectives simultaneously, resolving disagreements between departments, or building shared understanding quickly.", what does "simultaneously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (trạng từ): đồng thời. Tính từ: simultaneous (đồng thời); workshop giúp nghe nhiều góc nhìn cùng lúc.
items.explanationEn: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (adverb): at the same time. Adjective: simultaneous; a workshop lets you hear several viewpoints at once.

items.question: Trong câu "A facilitator separate from a note-taker.", từ "facilitator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A facilitator separate from a note-taker.", what does "facilitator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a person who takes the minutes
a person who guides a meeting
a person who funds the project
a person who signs off the work
items.explanation: facilitator /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪ.tər/ (danh từ): người điều phối buổi họp. Động từ: facilitate (tạo điều kiện, điều phối); "facilitate a workshop" = điều phối workshop.
items.explanationEn: facilitator /fəˈsɪl.ɪ.teɪ.tər/ (noun): a person who guides a meeting. Verb: facilitate; "facilitate a workshop" means guiding the discussion.

items.question: Trong câu "Many disagreements evaporate once everyone looks at the same picture.", từ "evaporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many disagreements evaporate once everyone looks at the same picture.", what does "evaporate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn from liquid into gas
items.explanation: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): tan biến. Nghĩa bóng: "disagreements evaporate" = bất đồng tự tan biến; nghĩa gốc là bay hơi.
items.explanationEn: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to fade away. Figurative use: "disagreements evaporate" means they disappear; the literal sense is turning into vapour.

items.question: Trong câu "A common trap: inviting too many people.", từ "trap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common trap: inviting too many people.", what does "trap" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a mistake easy to fall into
items.explanation: trap /træp/ (danh từ): sai lầm dễ mắc phải. "A common trap" = cái bẫy thường gặp; "fall into the trap of..." = mắc bẫy làm gì.
items.explanationEn: trap /træp/ (noun): a mistake easy to fall into. "A common trap" is a frequent mistake; "fall into the trap of..." means making that mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "What they actually do, as opposed to what they describe.", từ "as opposed to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "What they actually do, as opposed to what they describe.", what does "as opposed to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as opposed to /æz əˈpəʊzd tuː/ (cụm từ): trái với, chứ không phải. "As opposed to" dùng để đối lập hai thứ: làm thật, trái với lời mô tả.
items.explanationEn: as opposed to /æz əˈpəʊzd tuː/ (phrase): in contrast with. "As opposed to" contrasts two things: what people do versus what they say.

items.question: Trong câu "The workarounds — each one an unmet requirement.", từ "workaround" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The workarounds — each one an unmet requirement.", what does "workaround" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an unofficial way around a problem
the amount of work to do
items.explanation: workaround /ˈwɜːk.ə.raʊnd/ (danh từ): cách xoay xở tạm thời. Workaround = cách lách tạm để né hạn chế của hệ thống; mỗi workaround hé lộ một nhu cầu chưa được đáp ứng.
items.explanationEn: workaround /ˈwɜːk.ə.raʊnd/ (noun): an unofficial way around a problem. A workaround bypasses a system limitation; each one reveals a need the system does not meet.

items.question: Trong câu "The workarounds — each one an unmet requirement.", từ "unmet" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The workarounds — each one an unmet requirement.", what does "unmet" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (tính từ): chưa được đáp ứng. "Unmet need / requirement" = nhu cầu / yêu cầu chưa được đáp ứng; động từ gốc: meet a need.
items.explanationEn: unmet /ʌnˈmet/ (adjective): not yet satisfied. "An unmet need / requirement" is one not satisfied yet; from "meet a need".

items.question: Trong câu "This is a gold mine.", từ "gold mine" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is a gold mine.", what does "gold mine" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a place where gold is dug
items.explanation: gold mine /ˈɡəʊld maɪn/ (cụm từ): nguồn giá trị lớn. Nghĩa bóng: "a gold mine of information" = kho thông tin quý giá.
items.explanationEn: gold mine /ˈɡəʊld maɪn/ (phrase): a rich source of value. Figurative use: "a gold mine of information" is a very valuable source.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: every Excel spreadsheet a user maintains alongside the official system is an indictment of missing functionality.", từ "indictment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: every Excel spreadsheet a user maintains alongside the official system is an indictment of missing functionality.", what does "indictment" (noun) mean?
options: bằng chứng cho thấy thiếu sót
optionsEn: a sign that something is wrong
items.explanation: indictment /ɪnˈdaɪt.mənt/ (danh từ): bằng chứng cho thấy thiếu sót. "An indictment of something" (nghĩa bóng) = bằng chứng tố cáo sự yếu kém của cái gì; nghĩa gốc là bản cáo trạng.
items.explanationEn: indictment /ɪnˈdaɪt.mənt/ (noun): a sign that something is wrong. "An indictment of something" figuratively shows its failure; the legal sense is a formal charge.

items.question: Trong câu "Suitable when: you need input from many users, or quantitative data to confirm a hypothesis.", từ "hypothesis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Suitable when: you need input from many users, or quantitative data to confirm a hypothesis.", what does "hypothesis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθ.ə.sɪs/ (danh từ): giả thuyết. "Confirm / test a hypothesis" = xác nhận / kiểm chứng giả thuyết; số nhiều: hypotheses.
items.explanationEn: hypothesis /haɪˈpɒθ.ə.sɪs/ (noun): an idea to be tested. "Confirm / test a hypothesis" means checking an idea; plural: hypotheses.

items.question: Trong câu "Suitable when: you need input from many users, or quantitative data to confirm a hypothesis.", từ "quantitative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Suitable when: you need input from many users, or quantitative data to confirm a hypothesis.", what does "quantitative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: quantitative /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.tə.tɪv/ (tính từ): định lượng. "Quantitative data" = dữ liệu định lượng (con số); đối lập: qualitative (định tính).
items.explanationEn: quantitative /ˈkwɒn.tɪ.tə.tɪv/ (adjective): measured in numbers. "Quantitative data" is numeric; the opposite is qualitative.

items.question: Trong câu "Principles: keep it short, avoid leading questions, always include at least one open question, and always pilot it with a few people before sending it widely.", từ "pilot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Principles: keep it short, avoid leading questions, always include at least one open question, and always pilot it with a few people before sending it widely.", what does "pilot" (verb) mean?
options: thử nghiệm trước quy mô nhỏ
optionsEn: to test on a small scale
items.explanation: pilot /ˈpaɪ.lət/ (động từ): thử nghiệm trước quy mô nhỏ. "Pilot a survey / a feature" = chạy thử trên nhóm nhỏ; "a pilot project" = dự án thí điểm.
items.explanationEn: pilot /ˈpaɪ.lət/ (verb): to test on a small scale. "Pilot a survey / a feature" means trying it with a small group; "a pilot project" is a trial project.

items.question: Trong câu "Principles: keep it short, avoid leading questions, always include at least one open question, and always pilot it with a few people before sending it widely.", từ "leading question" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Principles: keep it short, avoid leading questions, always include at least one open question, and always pilot it with a few people before sending it widely.", what does "leading question" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a question that suggests its answer
a question with a free answer
items.explanation: leading question /ˈliː.dɪŋ ˈkwes.tʃən/ (cụm từ): câu hỏi mớm ý. "Avoid leading questions" = tránh câu hỏi dẫn dắt người trả lời theo ý mình.
items.explanationEn: leading question /ˈliː.dɪŋ ˈkwes.tʃən/ (phrase): a question that suggests its answer. "Avoid leading questions" means not steering people towards the answer you expect.

items.question: Trong câu "Documents: existing process descriptions, contracts, regulations, reports, support logs, and the backlog of outstanding change requests.", từ "outstanding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Documents: existing process descriptions, contracts, regulations, reports, support logs, and the backlog of outstanding change requests.", what does "outstanding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: outstanding /aʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn tồn đọng. "Outstanding issues / invoices" = vấn đề / hóa đơn còn tồn; nghĩa khác: xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: outstanding /aʊtˈstæn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): not yet dealt with. "Outstanding issues / invoices" are still unresolved; another sense is excellent.

items.question: Trong câu "Documents: existing process descriptions, contracts, regulations, reports, support logs, and the backlog of outstanding change requests.", từ "backlog" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Documents: existing process descriptions, contracts, regulations, reports, support logs, and the backlog of outstanding change requests.", what does "backlog" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (danh từ): danh sách việc tồn đọng. "Product backlog" = danh sách hạng mục chờ làm; "clear the backlog" = giải quyết hết việc tồn.
items.explanationEn: backlog /ˈbæk.lɒɡ/ (noun): work waiting to be done. "Product backlog" is the list of pending items; "clear the backlog" means finishing the pending work.

items.question: Trong câu "The support ticket repository is a ready-made list of pain points, and the change request backlog is a wish list already articulated by real users.", từ "ready-made" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The support ticket repository is a ready-made list of pain points, and the change request backlog is a wish list already articulated by real users.", what does "ready-made" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (tính từ): có sẵn. "A ready-made list / solution" = danh sách / giải pháp có sẵn, không cần tự xây.
items.explanationEn: ready-made /ˌred.iˈmeɪd/ (adjective): already prepared. "A ready-made list / solution" already exists and does not need to be built.

items.question: Trong câu "The support ticket repository is a ready-made list of pain points, and the change request backlog is a wish list already articulated by real users.", từ "pain point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The support ticket repository is a ready-made list of pain points, and the change request backlog is a wish list already articulated by real users.", what does "pain point" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: pain point /ˈpeɪn pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): vấn đề gây khó chịu. "Customer pain points" = những điểm khách hàng thấy phiền; cụm rất phổ biến trong kinh doanh và sản phẩm.
items.explanationEn: pain point /ˈpeɪn pɔɪnt/ (phrase): a recurring problem for users. "Customer pain points" are what frustrates customers; very common in business and product work.

items.question: Trong câu "Very few BAs mine these two sources.", từ "mine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Very few BAs mine these two sources.", what does "mine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mine /maɪn/ (động từ): khai thác (thông tin). "Mine data / sources" = khai thác dữ liệu / nguồn; "data mining" = khai phá dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: mine /maɪn/ (verb): to dig information out of. "Mine data / sources" means extracting value from them; "data mining" is the field.

items.question: Trong câu "Users who work by habit and cannot articulate it", từ "articulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users who work by habit and cannot articulate it", what does "articulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (động từ): diễn đạt rõ bằng lời. "Articulate a need" = nói rõ được nhu cầu; tính từ articulate = ăn nói lưu loát.
items.explanationEn: articulate /ɑːˈtɪk.jə.leɪt/ (verb): to express clearly in words. "Articulate a need" means expressing it clearly; the adjective means speaking fluently.

items.question: Trong câu "Users who work by habit and cannot articulate it", từ "by habit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users who work by habit and cannot articulate it", what does "by habit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by habit /baɪ ˈhæb.ɪt/ (cụm từ): theo thói quen. Người làm "by habit" thường không giải thích được lý do, nên quan sát tại chỗ hiệu quả hơn phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: by habit /baɪ ˈhæb.ɪt/ (phrase): out of routine. People who work "by habit" rarely explain why, so on-site observation beats interviews.

items.question: Trong câu "Resolving disagreement between departments", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resolving disagreement between departments", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết. "Resolve a conflict / an issue" = giải quyết xung đột / vấn đề; danh từ: resolution.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle a problem. "Resolve a conflict / an issue" means settling it; noun: resolution.

items.question: Trong câu "A legacy system with no documentation", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A legacy system with no documentation", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ, kế thừa (hệ thống). "Legacy system / code" = hệ thống / mã nguồn cũ vẫn đang chạy; danh từ legacy = di sản.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. "A legacy system / code" is old but still running; the noun means an inheritance.

items.question: Trong câu "Confirming an assumption", từ "assumption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Confirming an assumption", what does "assumption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (danh từ): giả định. "Make / test an assumption" = đưa ra / kiểm chứng giả định; động từ: assume.
items.explanationEn: assumption /əˈsʌmp.ʃən/ (noun): something believed without proof. "Make / test an assumption" means forming / checking a belief; verb: assume.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements still very vague", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements still very vague", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ. "Vague requirements" = yêu cầu mơ hồ; lúc này làm prototype để lấy phản hồi là cách tốt.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): not clear or precise. "Vague requirements" are unclear; prototyping to get feedback helps.

items.question: Trong câu "Prototyping and gathering feedback", từ "prototype" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prototyping and gathering feedback", what does "prototype" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prototype /ˈprəʊ.tə.taɪp/ (động từ): làm bản mẫu thử. Danh từ: a prototype (bản mẫu); "a clickable prototype" = bản mẫu có thể bấm thử.
items.explanationEn: prototype /ˈprəʊ.tə.taɪp/ (verb): to build an early sample. Noun: a prototype; "a clickable prototype" lets users click through screens.

items.question: Trong câu "Needing input from hundreds of people", từ "input" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Needing input from hundreds of people", what does "input" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (danh từ): ý kiến đóng góp. "Get input from users" = lấy ý kiến người dùng; cụm quen thuộc trong email: "Thanks for your input."
items.explanationEn: input /ˈɪn.pʊt/ (noun): ideas or views offered. "Get input from users" means collecting their views; a common email line: "Thanks for your input."

items.question: Trong câu "The most important principle: never rely on a single technique.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important principle: never rely on a single technique.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa hoàn toàn vào. "Rely on something" = phụ thuộc vào cái gì; tính từ: reliable (đáng tin cậy).
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Rely on something" means depending on it; adjective: reliable.

items.question: Trong câu "Each has its own blind spot.", từ "blind spot" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each has its own blind spot.", what does "blind spot" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: blind spot /ˈblaɪnd spɒt/ (cụm từ): điểm mù. "Have a blind spot" = có điểm mù, khía cạnh không nhìn thấy được; mỗi kỹ thuật đều có.
items.explanationEn: blind spot /ˈblaɪnd spɒt/ (phrase): an area you cannot see. "Have a blind spot" means missing something you cannot see; every technique has one.

items.question: Trong câu "Cross-checking those three is where you find the truth.", từ "cross-check" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cross-checking those three is where you find the truth.", what does "cross-check" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cross-check /ˌkrɒsˈtʃek/ (động từ): đối chiếu chéo. "Cross-check the data" = đối chiếu dữ liệu từ nhiều nguồn để tìm chỗ vênh.
items.explanationEn: cross-check /ˌkrɒsˈtʃek/ (verb): to verify against other sources. "Cross-check the data" means comparing several sources to find mismatches.

items.question: Trong câu "Analysis planning is the most-skipped area — few pause to ask how much effort is proportionate to the risk.", từ "proportionate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Analysis planning is the most-skipped area — few pause to ask how much effort is proportionate to the risk.", what does "proportionate" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: in the right amount relative to
items.explanation: proportionate /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.ət/ (tính từ): tương xứng. "Proportionate to the risk" = tương xứng với rủi ro; trái nghĩa: disproportionate.
items.explanationEn: proportionate /prəˈpɔː.ʃən.ət/ (adjective): in the right amount relative to. "Proportionate to the risk" means matching its size; opposite: disproportionate.

items.question: Trong câu "BABOK gives you a map for noticing which group of work you are skipping, not a process to follow mechanically.", từ "mechanically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BABOK gives you a map for noticing which group of work you are skipping, not a process to follow mechanically.", what does "mechanically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: mechanically /məˈkæn.ɪ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): máy móc, rập khuôn. "Follow a process mechanically" = làm theo quy trình một cách rập khuôn, không suy nghĩ.
items.explanationEn: mechanically /məˈkæn.ɪ.kəl.i/ (adverb): without thought. "Follow a process mechanically" means doing it by rote, without thinking.

items.question: Trong câu "Elicitation is hard because most important information is tacit knowledge users never think to mention.", từ "mention" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicitation is hard because most important information is tacit knowledge users never think to mention.", what does "mention" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (động từ): nhắc đến. "Never think to mention" = không nghĩ tới việc nhắc đến; "not to mention" = chưa kể đến.
items.explanationEn: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (verb): to refer to briefly. "Never think to mention" means it never occurs to them to say it; "not to mention" means and also.

items.question: Trong câu "Interviews, workshops, observation, surveys, and document analysis each have their own strengths and blind spots.", từ "strength" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interviews, workshops, observation, surveys, and document analysis each have their own strengths and blind spots.", what does "strength" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: strength /streŋθ/ (danh từ): điểm mạnh. "Strengths and weaknesses" = điểm mạnh và điểm yếu; câu hỏi phỏng vấn xin việc rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: strength /streŋθ/ (noun): a good quality. "Strengths and weaknesses" is a very common job-interview topic.

items.question: Trong câu "The word elicitation was chosen over gathering because requirements do not lie around waiting to be collected.", từ "collect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The word elicitation was chosen over gathering because requirements do not lie around waiting to be collected.", what does "collect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: collect /kəˈlekt/ (động từ): thu thập. Yêu cầu không nằm sẵn để "collect" (thu nhặt), mà phải "elicit" (khơi gợi).
items.explanationEn: collect /kəˈlekt/ (verb): to gather together. Requirements are not simply collected; they must be elicited.
